payload.title: Review Brief: Institutional Dependency Graph
payload.summary: Codex PR #8 has been merged into main. I reviewed the actual implementation files and tests. The delivery satisfies the requested Institutional Dependency Graph package at the implementation level.
implementation_summary: Added src/estate/core/dependency_graph.py as the explicit dependency graph generator.
Registered dependency-graph CLI command in src/estate/cli/main.py with --json support.
Reads explicit dependency fields from JSON artifacts and clearly labeled dependency sections/fields from Markdown artifacts.
Reports nodes, edges, orphaned items, inputs used/unavailable, and warnings.
ca3_findings: The implementation preserves the critical architectural boundary: it records only explicit dependencies and does not infer hidden dependencies from naming, prose, similarity, order, or proximity.
The generator supports declared JSON dependency fields such as dependencies, depends_on, dependency_ids, blocked_by, requires, required_capabilities, required_services, and work_package_dependencies.
Markdown extraction supports front matter, field lines, and clearly headed dependency sections such as Dependencies, Depends On, Blocked By, Requires, Required Capabilities, and Required Services.
Missing optional inputs, malformed JSON, malformed references, and artifacts without explicit dependency fields are reported as warnings rather than fatal errors.
The report intentionally surfaces orphaned items where no explicit incoming or outgoing dependency edges exist.
Tests cover valid JSON and Markdown extraction, missing dependency fields/orphaning, malformed JSON handling, Markdown output content, and CLI registration.
lifecycle_assessment: Institutional Dependency Graph should be treated as Implemented.
Operational validation remains pending until the command is run against the live local Estate state and the resulting dependency graph is reviewed for usefulness by CA2/CA3/Steward.
The current generated graph showing zero explicit edges is not an implementation failure; it reflects that many Estate artifacts do not yet declare dependencies explicitly.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether the explicit-only dependency policy is correct for this stage of the Estate.
Review whether missing dependency fields should remain warnings or be downgraded for artifacts where dependencies are optional.
Determine whether future work should add dependency fields to work packages, capability registry entries, and operational artifacts.
Confirm that generated dependency outputs are operational reports and not governance sources of truth.
recommended_next_validation: Review orphaned items and warnings to determine where explicit dependency metadata should be added later.
Decide whether the capability remains Implemented or can advance toward Operationally Validated after real-use review.
